text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C after large gains realized profits, but I should base future sales on prospects and portfolio balance, not gains alone.","My account value declined after early gains, reminding me to assess the whole portfolio and manage risk rather than focus on individual winning trades.","I made no trades through several losing periods, then bought A, B, and C; I should review holdings objectively and avoid both holding losers out of loss aversion and buying without a clear rationale."]}
